none: PAS BM-D44087: BM-D44087: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the second or third centuries AD. The sealing is rectangular in shape and section. The upper surface of the sealing is struck with a rectangular die with the legend 'DN' in relief, translating as '​d(omini) n(ostri). ​'(Property) of Our Lord (the Emperor)' whereas the lower surface is plain.
